title: Arkavo Taxonomy Map v1
description: Versioned mapping from taxonomy labels to OpenTDF attributes. The map is data, not policy: it says which attributes a label implies and what happens to a payload whose requester does not hold them. Authorization itself stays with the KAS and the policy decision point.

version.description: Map version, recorded in sentinel evidence and bound by the pack manifest signature

namespace.description: Attribute namespace every definition FQN extends

attributeDefinitions.description: OpenTDF attribute definitions. Definitions are conjunctive with one another: a requester must satisfy every definition a label names.

rule.description: hierarchy: ordered levels, holding a level grants every lower level. allOf: requester must hold every named value. anyOf: requester must hold at least one.

order.description: For hierarchy definitions, platform creation order is highest privilege to lowest. Runtime lookup is by value name, not by index. Reordering is unsafe: it changes access on existing TDFs.

values.description: Known values as single-segment lowercase slugs. An empty array means the definition is populated per tenant or via dynamic value mappings.

dynamicValueMapping.description: Pulls values from the entity representation so a definition can scale without registering every value. ANY_OF and ALL_OF only; cannot combine with value-level subject mappings. Comparison is case-sensitive.

onTdf.description: When false, this definition organizes the corpus (which knowledge adapter to train) and is never written to TDF dataAttributes.

labels.description: Taxonomy labels a classifier or reference tier may emit

sensitivity.description: SensitivityLevel floor this label implies. Merging labels takes the maximum.

requires.description: Attributes the requester must hold. Conjunctive across definitions.

wrapAttributes.description: Attributes placed in dataAttributes when a payload carrying this label is wrapped for transport

unentitled.description: Disposition when the requester does not hold the required attributes. Wrapping never rescues an unauthorized disclosure, so allow is not a legal value here.

neverRelease.description: Blocked unconditionally regardless of entitlement, wrapping, or destination

derived.description: Second table: data-derived definitions in a separate namespace. The sentinel still only labels; this table is the only place a derived label becomes a data attribute. Open-ended tags never appear here. At wrap, every derived tag is asserted; a tag is stamped as a data attribute only when stamp is true, the value is declared, and its score meets threshold. ALL_OF only — ANY_OF would let an unpromoted tag bypass a promoted conjunct. Promotion tightens subject mapping on an already-stamped value; it does not add the value at wrap.

rule.description: Derived definitions are ALL_OF. A document tagged {sales, pricing} stays conjunctive so promoting pricing restricts even a holder of still-universal sales.

threshold.description: Scores below this stay in the assertion only. After promotion a false positive is a denial; a false negative leaves the prescribed baseline.

stamp.description: When false, tags for this definition are asserted but never become dataAttributes.

promoted.description: Values whose subject mapping is no longer universal. Wrap still stamps them; promotion is a KAS mapping change and a rewrap of already-tagged TDFs.

derivedArtifactJoin.description: How a derived artifact (adapter, sentinel, index) inherits the policies of its training inputs at wrap. This is a property of what an adapter is — a lossy copy of its corpus — not of any one tenant. Hierarchical attributes take the maximum (existing high-water mark). Conjunctive attributes take the union. Provenance attributes are stamped only from asserted facets; a miss is fail-closed.

hierarchy.description: Clearance and any other hierarchy definition: the derived artifact carries the maximum of its inputs.

allOf.description: Conjunctive definitions (project, department): the derived artifact carries every value any input carried. An archive-wide adapter therefore demands allOf every collection it saw.

provenanceAttributes.description: Attribute FQNs that may only be stamped from asserted provenance (a connector join), never from the sentinel. Empty means the tenant has not bound the facet and opt-out is omit, not a second code path.

missingProvenance.description: unknown: stamp the definition's unknown value, entitled to nobody, and exclude the item from partitioned adapters. omit: do not stamp the attribute (tenant has not bound the facet).

obligationTriggers.description: PDP-to-PEP directives that accompany a permit. An obligation is not stamped on the TDF; it fires off a resource attribute value. A PEP that cannot enforce the obligation must refuse.

resourceAttribute.description: Value FQN on the resource that arms the trigger, e.g. https://attr.arkavo.com/attr/project/value/mallinckrodt

obligations.description: Obligation definitions. Grammar is <namespace>/obl/<name> for the definition and <namespace>/obl/<name>/value/<value> for the value. An obligation never grants decryption.

grantsDecryption.description: Always false. An obligation that granted decryption would be an entitlement.
